renderer: Unchanged WL101 optimized selective lifecycle (B_sel), same ECRO weights, fixed SSS cfg family
workload: V_SSS_TOUR first measured tour [0,2,3,4,5,6,7,1], after the original warm-up visit sequence
gpu: LabServer63 RTX 3080 Ti, 12 GiB, driver and process OptiX 595.71.05
physical_reference: Original WL101 six-event physical references, 2 × 4096 spp each, seeds 101100 + 10 × state and 101101 + 10 × state. Cfg0 files must match WL101A hashes. Historical references are used only by the offline scorer.

reconstruction.method: SVGF adaptation on joint linear-HDR RGB (E1+E2+HL). Temporal accumulation of RGB and luminance moments, variance guidance and edge-aware 5x5 a-trous at steps 1,2,4. No material demodulation: SSS albedo is a transport coefficient.
reconstruction.history_invalidation: Any geometry or source change resets all radiance history. This prevents stale indirect light across rigid edits. Reset also on explicit request, first frame and incompatible resolution. Same geometry/light permits static or camera-only reprojection.
reconstruction.motion: Reproject current center-ray world positions into the previous camera; nearest previous pixel, same object ID, normal agreement, world-position agreement at the projected footprint. Invalidate when off screen or occluded. SSS view angle gate. Surface appearance at subpixel boundaries remains a limitation. Additionally trace an exact previous-eye segment visibility ray on camera moves, qualifying it against an independent closest-hit query.
reconstruction.clip: No radiance clipping, history-color clamping, artificial energy correction or reference input. Frozen display exposure is the WL101A exposure.

evaluation.camera_sequence: A sixteen frames; B four frames; A four frames. A is archived cfg0 camera. B camera origin x+0.08 m, same target and FOV. Raw and same-frame reconstruction with reset are controls. Camera B has no independent high-SPP reference; evaluate return to A against the existing reference.
evaluation.dynamic_sequence: 8 original SSS tour states. For each edit keep advancing a live reconstruction object; run a same-frame forced-reset control. No temporal reservoir carries radiance across geometry changes.
evaluation.seed: 10171000 + (100000 * sequence_index) + (10000 * spp) + (1000 * repeat) + frame_index. Sequence 0 static, 1 tour, 2 camera. Performance seeds disjoint.
evaluation.roi: WL101A center-ray sphere, 4-pixel inner boundary, floor and contact/sphere-shadow. Add newly visible camera pixels checked by an independent old-camera visibility ray.
evaluation.quality: Compute HDR absolute/relative RMSE and L1, fixed-transfer LDR RMSE, ROI gradient relative RMSE and energy, inter-replicate noise and variance-debiased stable MSE. Score frame difference errors against two consecutive physical targets on the geometry tour. Measure fixed-camera temporal standard deviation and camera-history difference against the same noisy frame with forced reset.
evaluation.timing: 32 measured warm tour events / SPP / raw and reconstructed, paired seed and same selective update stack. Synchronized host wall edit through device-resident RGB completion. Excludes readback, disk, initial shader compilation and analysis. Report median, P95 and denoiser-only GPU events including temporal reprojection/filter kernels; include first-hit guide generation in end-to-end. Separately record warmed camera-only end-to-end wall for the two designated viewpoints.
evaluation.retention: Retain static and tour raw/reconstructed frame pairs. The first sixteen camera-sequence warm-up frames are recorded by seed and input identity. Retain all eight moving/return frames and explicit-reset controls at the two view transitions. Compare tour forced reset bitwise on every frame and retain the Boolean instead of a duplicate array.

acceptance.integrity: Original estimator equivalence (relative L1 <= 1e-6 for identical seed, table, cam, SPP), identity/reference hashes, static one-sample and constant-color checks, image-space history invalidity in disocclusions, no leak from old radiance at geometry change and no reference exposure.
acceptance.quality: At both SPPs require >=40% static steady HDR MSE reduction, >=25% cold and tour HDR MSE reduction for sphere, floor, contact; all corresponding LDR RMSEs improve. Boundary/contact steady and tour gradient error below raw and mean gradient energy ratio to physical in [0.80,1.20].
acceptance.temporal: Static steady linear HDR temporal variance <=50% of raw in sphere/floor; exact forced-reset equivalence on every tour edit; moving-camera independently visible test detects no more than 0.5% retention on independently disoccluded pixels. At first return to A, disocclusion-region reconstructed HDR RMSE <=1.10× same-frame spatial reset control.
acceptance.budget_rule: Both 1 and 4 spp report against the same 20 ms median 512² interactive objective. A pass needs the quality, temporal and timing gates at the corresponding SPP. Do not extrapolate a real-time claim.
acceptance.stop: Stop at integrity failure, severe temporal or detail failure, or unmet cost with a reproducible bottleneck. No alternative renderer, new representation or rerun with post-hoc filter tuning.
